caseStudies.title: Moving Ops & Dispatch Coordination
caseStudies.description: Coordinated 8-10 jobs daily across 11-truck fleet with 28-min estimate turnaround and 72% review rate.
caseStudies.context: Moving company with 11 trucks running 8-10 jobs daily across a defined service region. Operations run end-to-end: survey → inventory → estimate → CRM entry → dispatch → post-move outreach.
caseStudies.problem: High job volume with multiple handoff points created risk for missed notes, delayed updates, and scheduling drift.
actions: Owned full survey-to-dispatch workflow: captured inventory details, estimated times, and customer preferences
Maintained real-time schedule visibility across 8-10 daily jobs, coordinating truck/crew assignments
Executed post-move outreach within review collection window, contributing to 72% submission rate
Built and maintained tracker hygiene so nothing fell through
caseStudies.improvement: Would implement automated reminder system for follow-ups and integrate CRM with dispatch scheduling.

caseStudies.title: Disputes Triage & Queue Discipline
caseStudies.description: Managed 65+ tickets daily with 92% QA. Contributed to 1,500→0 backlog reduction in 15 days.
caseStudies.context: Primary triage specialist for US fintech company (team of 12 agents) handling card disputes, chargebacks, and billing issues.
caseStudies.problem: Growing dispute queue with inconsistent intake documentation causing downstream rework and delays.
actions: Standardized triage intake with structured note templates for complete documentation
Implemented routing discipline so tickets reached the right specialists consistently
Reduced rework caused by incomplete intake by implementing mandatory fields
Prioritized queue based on downstream impact and urgency
results: Contributed to team initiative: 1,500-case backlog → 0 in 15 days
92% QA score on triage accuracy and documentation
89% CSAT maintaining satisfaction during dispute resolution
caseStudies.improvement: Would implement automated escalation triggers based on case age and amount at risk.

caseStudies.title: Customer Support (Chat + Email)
caseStudies.description: Maintained consistent quality across high-volume support workflows for influencer marketplace.
caseStudies.context: Influencer marketplace platform with customer base reaching out via chat and email. Support operated through structured ticket workflows.
caseStudies.problem: Maintaining consistency in response time, tone, and documentation across 40+ hours weekly.
actions: Processed incoming tickets through Zendesk with complete intake documentation
Categorized and prioritized queue items based on urgency and type
Maintained calm, consistent written communication across every interaction
results: Consistent response quality across concurrent roles
Complete intake documentation for downstream teams
caseStudies.improvement: Would create template library for common inquiry types to reduce response time.

caseStudies.title: Content + Shopify/Canva Execution
caseStudies.description: Achieved 100% on-time publication delivery with consistent brand assets across all client deliverables.
caseStudies.context: Media & content coordinator managing multi-client publishing schedules and asset production.
caseStudies.problem: Multiple clients with different publishing requirements and content formats.
actions: Managed content calendar across platforms, keeping deadlines visible and on-track
Prepared and organized assets: formatted variants, labeled revisions, ready for upload
Executed Shopify store updates: product listings, imagery, basic merchandising
results: Consistent brand consistency across all published content
caseStudies.improvement: Would implement content batch creation workflow to reduce per-piece production time.

caseStudies.context: Personal project to create professional portfolio showcasing operations and support work.
